# hestiacp_dns_record (Resource)

Manages a single DNS record within a HestiaCP DNS zone.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) DNS zone the record belongs to.
- `record` (String) Record name, e.g. `www`, `@`, `mail`.
- `type` (String) Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, etc.
- `value` (String) Record value / IP address.

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Record priority (used for MX/SRV records). Defaults to `10`.
- `user` (String) HestiaCP username that owns this record's zone. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
